request:
镜头 s10：纪录片细节特写镜头，时长 7 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：observational documentary footage from a research institute's own 2050s film archive, shot on Super 16 colour negative: lively visible grain, slightly soft resolution, cold fluorescent light mixed with one warm desk lamp, muted desaturated palette, deep shadows, imperfect handheld framing
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary insert close-up grabbed handheld, focus breathing
导演意图（自然语言）：微距，缓慢横移，从一只铁盒移到另一只。两只没有任何连线的铁盒，小灯各自闪着红光，忽然同时变成绿色，同步闪了三下。环境声：两声轻轻的提示音、机房嗡鸣。
情绪：quiet, wondrous, precise
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：close-up, slow lateral slide from the near box to the far box
景深与虚实：Shallow focus that racks from the near box to the far box; the bench in between softly blurred.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Insert on the workbench at night: two identical dented tin boxes with antennas sit at opposite ends of the bench, not connected by any cable; each shows one small red LED. Blocking lock: one tin box sits in the foreground at frame left, the second further along the bench at frame right, no cable between them; lamp light from above.
Picture 2: Song's prototype node (the dented tin box, still without a sticker) (prop reference; role: prop reference). A handmade prototype network node: an old dented steel tin box with a plain scratched olive-grey lid, a salvaged circuit board, a small heat sink, three tiny LEDs and a short screw-on antenna, on a cluttered lab workbench under a desk lamp. No sticker on the lid.
Picture 3: the 550 project laboratory at night (2050s) (location reference; role: location reference). Interior of the quantum-computer laboratory of a national research institute at night in the 2050s: a long cluttered engineer's workbench with a soldering station, oscilloscopes, coils of wire, circuit boards and notebooks under a desk lamp; behind a large glass wall, a cold clean server hall with rows of tall black cabinets and, on the central black cabinet, a single round red-glowing camera lens exactly like the terminal in the reference image. Fluorescent tubes. Empty of people.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：two soft electronic chimes, low lab hum
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。
